architectureNotes: The merged code agrees with both decisions. mean is a named export in src/stats.js. It throws RangeError('mean: empty array') on empty input and never returns NaN for an array of finite numbers. One numerical edge case is still open: mean computes sum(xs)/xs.length, so when the sum overflows it returns Infinity even though the true mean is finite (for example mean([Number.MAX_VALUE, Number.MAX_VALUE])). This does not break the 'never NaN' rule. Any later unit that builds on mean or sum (variance, standard deviation) should know about it.
